transmission expansion or economic dispatch presented as direct distribution expansion evidence
search snippets without a resolvable title/identifier
papers whose metadata conflict with the cited identity
claims of AC feasibility without candidate-level network mapping and stated voltage/loading/convergence checks
claims that separate parameter and strategy adaptation when the evaluated switch changes both

Publisher pages intermittently returned 429 or anti-bot responses; exact-DOI discovery and stable bibliographic mirrors were used transparently where needed.
No citation counts were used because they were not needed for claim support and were not consistently verifiable in this environment.
Search results are a targeted evidence map rather than a systematic-review census.
